name: services/blobbox/chmod
description: Update an existing blob's sharing options.
brief_description: Update an existing blob's sharing options.

arguments.name: blob_id
arguments.description: ID of the blob (you got it from the put_* method). It has to exist and you have to be its owner.

arguments.name: read_access
arguments.description: One of the options listed in the put_text method, or a special skip option to indicate that you don't want to change the previous settings.

arguments.name: min_age
arguments.description:
One of the options listed in the put_text method, or a special skip option to indicate that you don't want to change the previous settings.

Just to clear up: We will count this age starting from the current time (and not from the original upload time).

arguments.name: max_age
arguments.description:
One of the options listed in the put_text method, or a special skip option to indicate that you don't want to change the previous settings.

Just to clear up: We will count this age starting from the current time (and not from the original upload time).

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: Currently, this method always returns the same value: a dictionary with single success key with values of true.
